{{Quote|I only know what my employer requires me to know. Particularly, about the war between the Gungans and Imperials.|[[Vaik'anna Silverlight]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VS">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=herald|Vaik'anna Silverlight|Naboo}}</ref>}}
The '''Imperial vs. Gungan Battle''' was an ongoing conflict between forces of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and [[Gungan/Legends|Gungans]] loyal to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==The Battle==
{{Quote|It is such a tragedy. The Gungans are so peaceful, so cute and kind. Well, Jar Jar--I met him once. He's a bit annoying. Anyway! You can find the site of their most recent battle at the location I downloaded in your datapad.|Vaik'anna Silverlight, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:VS" />}}
The battle took place at a Gungan monument on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] sometime after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. The battle involved at least one [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]], several [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]], and many [[wetland assault stormtrooper]]s against a horde of plainclothes Gungans loyal to the Rebel Alliance. By at least [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]], the Gungans had succeeded in destroying the AT-AT and [[Death/Legends|killing]] all the [[Color/Legends|white]] [[Stormtrooper armor/Legends|armored]] stormtroopers, but fighting continued to persist between them and the many remaining swamptroopers.<ref name="SWG:IvGB" /> An individual by the name of [[Montrus]] was situated close to the battle, at the base of the Gungan monument.<ref name="SWG:BA">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=general|Borvo's Assignments|Naboo}}</ref> The [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Noble/Legends|noble]] [[Roric V`lia]] and his employee [[Vaik'anna Silverlight]] had activities related to the battle.<ref name="SWG:VS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial vs. Gungan Battle appeared in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:IvGB" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
